title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Each Order Stands on Its Own
content:
**Rule.** Under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a customer may have any number of orders, in any mix of fulfilment programs, open at once. There is no maximum number of orders per customer.

Each order is its own record, with its own payment, fees, return windows and adjustments, and nothing on one order is netted against another. Thresholds such as free-shipping minimums and minimum order amounts are measured on the single order's merchandise subtotal and never by combining orders.

**Questions this rule answers.**
- *Two Ship to Home orders placed the same day each fall short of the free-shipping minimum but together exceed it — is shipping waived?* No. Each order's own merchandise subtotal is measured; the two are never combined.
- *A refund is owed on one order while a fee stands on another — is one set against the other?* No. Each order keeps its own payment, fees and refunds.
- *Does a customer's open Drive Up order prevent a new Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order?* No. Any number of orders in any mix of programs may be open at once.
